summary_en: 400,000 shares (0.71% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-12 at closing price of ¥492/share, maximum total ¥196.8M. Settlement after market close same day. Constitutes first tranche of larger 1.2M-share (2.14% S/O) ¥700M program authorized for June 12–30, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases.
title_en: Notice regarding purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-12, i-mobile announced a single-day share repurchase block via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading. The company will place buy orders at the prior day's closing price of ¥492/share for up to 400,000 shares (0.71% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury), with a maximum outlay of ¥196.8M. Results will be disclosed after market close the same day. This block represents the first tranche of a larger 1.2M-share (2.14% S/O) ¥700M repurchase program authorized by the board on 2026-06-11 and set to run through 2026-06-30, executable via both ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases. The buyback follows agreements with two major shareholders—CEO Tetsuya Noguchi (6.46% holder, 3.62M shares) and Board Chair Toshihiko Tanaka (6.75% holder, 3.78M shares)—to sell portions of their stakes.
